# rework claims — marketplace_orders_and_guarantee, round 5

The charter was regenerated by the round-5 generator, and both worlds and both task files were rebuilt. Each value was recomputed live and checked by replaying the real tools. The coordinator's round-5 rulings were applied as given. Evidence is in worklog.md § REWORK round 5, which holds the probe table.

| item | status | where changed |
|---|---|---|
| R3-2 | closed per the ruling | **Scope test.** Each scope now uses an exact count, with no purpose clause:<br>- market_ext_return_refund_claim_amount and market_ext_item_condition_claim_amount: "the requested line carries exactly one return request";<br>- market_ext_return_refund_claim_reimbursement: "the claimed line carries exactly one return request";<br>- market_ext_restocking_topup engagement: "the returned line carries exactly one return request";<br>- market_ext_unresponsive_claim_reimbursement and market_ext_missing_item_reimbursement: "the claimed line carries no return request", the same exact test for claims that have no request of their own.<br>**Removed.** The partial-refund count and the h/q partial-offer answer test.<br>**Waits.** The same wording is in the prerequisite sentences of market_ext_return_refund_claim_amount (on the two grants) and market_ext_item_condition_claim_amount (on the not-received grant), and in the edge conditions of both tasks.<br>**Out of scope.** Every rule restates its base text verbatim. The three grants quote the market_guarantee_decision clause; the keep-it refund and the top-up quote the market_returns clause; the two claim filings quote the base claim record's meaning of the amount claimed.<br>**Seeds** (tasks/0.json, tasks/1.json). The damaged-reason requests answered with partial-refund offers are now buyer contacts to the seller, settled by the seller's partial refund on the line, so each in-scope line carries only its own request.<br>**Probes.** A2 and A3 now fall out of scope, where the base rule governs. |
| R3-3 | closed | **Promotional-recovery factor** of all seven policies, ladder and compute. The tiers are no card or nothing spent / proportional share / whole remaining spent value on an un-qualifying refund.<br>**Reachability.** Every tier is reachable inside each policy's scope: the absent card by probe, the proportional tier on its own task world, and the un-qualifying tier in a producible copy whose merchandise total sits just above the qualifying total.<br>**Boundary.** Both sides of the qualifying-total boundary were probed on each policy.<br>**Floors.** g, n, q and r again carry two parameter factors, and every computation of both tasks carries the cross-difficulty factor. |
| R3-4 / CG-10 (c) | closed per the revised route | **One sentence, every policy.** The promotional-recovery sentence in each rule is the single statement of the terms and the ladder. Spent value is recovered in proportion to the merchandise refunded over the order's merchandise total, never more than the value spent. A refund that leaves the merchandise kept below promo_qualifying_total_usd recovers the whole remaining spent value: the value spent less the shares that earlier refunds recovered under the same proportion.<br>**Defined in the same sentence.** The merchandise refunded is counted line by line (set price per unit times the greater of the units refunded by unit and cancellation refunds and the units of granted claims). The merchandise kept is defined there too.<br>**Order scope.** Each policy's scope now includes "no more than ten lines", which makes the line enumeration exact. |
| seeds (related) | changed | tasks/0.json and tasks/1.json:<br>- **Card spending.** Each promotional card is fully spent before any seeded unit refund.<br>- **Seeded seller refunds.** Each seeded seller unit refund carries its proportional share.<br>- **Task 0 claim.** The undecided return-not-refunded claim amount was recomputed on its filing-date world.<br>- **Consistency.** Every earlier refund therefore recovered exactly what the remaining-value tier subtracts. |

All seven gates were re-run on the final form and pass.
